description: Independently review repeated triggers, state synchronization and failure recovery in a Minecraft UGC design.
use_cases: Counterexample-driven review of correctness and abnormal states.

deployment_geography.cloud_data: Local review material may be included in the cloud planner's later context.

requirements.credentials: Gateway-managed provider authentication; never supplied in meeting context.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Agreeing with other agents without independent evidence can hide duplicate rewards or lost state.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Require counterexamples and explicit resolution reasons; distinguish review conclusions from actual game tests.

ethical_considerations: No art integration or asset generation.
Do not claim model opinions are game test results.
Use only meeting material permitted for the configured cloud data boundary.
